name: Junta de Traslaloma (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Junta de Traslaloma (a castle, a sun and a horse).
history: Municipal flag of Junta de Traslaloma; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Junta de Traslaloma arms — castle, sun and horse
